nlp.originalTitle: Sentiment Analysis Performance of Lora-Enhanced Llm's
nlp.catchyTitle: Boosting Sentiment Analysis: How LoRA Supercharges DistilBERT on Social Media
nlp.summary: This study evaluates eight machine learning, deep learning, and transformer models for Twitter sentiment analysis. Fine-tuning DistilBERT with LoRA achieved the highest accuracy at 82.38%. The findings highlight that parameter-efficient fine-tuning significantly outperforms traditional approaches in short-text classification.

nlp.originalTitle: Comparing and Contrasting Forced Aligned Acoustic Models for Vernacular Speech
nlp.catchyTitle: Tuning in to Vernacular: Testing Forced Alignment on Appalachian English
nlp.summary: This study evaluated the Montreal Forced Aligner on Appalachian English using a pretrained model compared to manual alignment. With low error rates between 0.54% and 1.3%, the aligner handled dialect variations effectively. Researchers can reliably use this tool for vernacular speech analysis on high-quality recordings.

cv.originalTitle: A Lightweight Browser-Based Facial Recognition Framework for Preventing Impersonation in Computer-Based Examinations
cv.catchyTitle: Stopping Exam Cheaters: Lightweight Real-Time Facial Recognition for Browser-Based Testing
cv.summary: This study introduces a browser-based facial recognition system to prevent student impersonation in computer-based exams. Built with face-api.js and liveness detection, it achieved 94.7% verification accuracy with fast response times. The scalable framework offers a secure biometric solution that upholds academic integrity.

cv.originalTitle: A REVIEW OF MULTIBAND IMAGING TECHNIQUES IN AGRICULTURE
cv.catchyTitle: Seeing Beyond Visible Light: How Multiband Imaging is Transforming Modern Agriculture
cv.summary: This review explores multiband imaging techniques that capture multiple spectral bands across the electromagnetic spectrum. By surpassing standard single-channel vision, this approach provides deeper analytical insights. Consequently, it plays a vital role in advancing precision agriculture to boost food production.
authors: Indian Journal of Science and Research
